title: Moving Between Wayfare Driver Levels: Active-Days Minimum and Inspection Requirement
content:
A move to a higher service level under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product depends on two level figures, the same on every Wayfare level.

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days an agreement must have been active before moving to a higher level (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Level change requires an inspection of the vehicle valid on the change date | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

The 30-day figure is counted in calendar days from the activation date. The inspection requirement is "yes" on all six levels: a level change needs a vehicle inspection valid on the change date.

Hypothetical reading: on a hypothetical agreement whose inspection on file expired the week before, the inspection is not valid on the change date.
